title: SQLAlchemy ORM models for core schema
description:
Create chatbot/db/models.py with SQLAlchemy 2.0 declarative ORM models.

Define these tables using Mapped[] column annotations and mapped_column():
- User: id (UUID pk, default uuid4), external_id (str, unique, indexed), display_name (str), created_at (UTC datetime), updated_at (UTC datetime)
- Session: id (UUID pk), user_id (FK→User.id), title (str, nullable), is_active (bool), created_at, updated_at
- Message: id (UUID pk), session_id (FK→Session.id), role (str — user/assistant/system/tool), content (text), embedding (pgvector vector(None) — see note), token_count (int, nullable), created_at
- Episode: id (UUID pk), session_id (FK→Session.id), title (str), summary (text, nullable), start_message_id (FK→Message.id, nullable), end_message_id (FK→Message.id, nullable), created_at
- SemanticFact: id (UUID pk), user_id (FK→User.id), fact_text (text), embedding (pgvector vector(None) — see note), source_message_id (FK→Message.id, nullable), confidence (float, default 1.0), created_at, updated_at
- Entity: id (UUID pk), name (str, indexed), entity_type (str), metadata_json (JSON, nullable), created_at

All tables use a declarative Base from sqlalchemy.orm.DeclarativeBase. Use UUID primary keys from the uuid module with server_default=sa.text('gen_random_uuid()'). Use sa.sql.func.now() for created_at defaults. Add relationship() backrefs where appropriate (User.sessions, Session.messages, Session.episodes).

CRITICAL: The embedding column must use pgvector's Vector type. Import from pgvector.sqlalchemy: `from pgvector.sqlalchemy import Vector`. Use `Vector(dimensions=None)` initially so the operator can set the dimension when the embedding provider is chosen (see phase risk notes). The 0001 migration will make the dimension concrete.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task c.2)
- Any existing files in allowed_write_paths

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/db/models.py exists and defines User, Session, Message, Episode, SemanticFact, Entity
All tables use UUID primary keys
Message and SemanticFact include a pgvector Vector column named embedding
An import of all model classes succeeds without errors
